# NavigationAgent

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("NavigationAgent")`

Walks its parent part to a point across the walkable ground, avoiding other agents on the way. The engine moves the part on simulation time: set `Target`, and `Reached` fires when the part arrives.

For a single character, a script that follows the waypoints from `FindPath` is enough. Use agents for many characters that must not walk through each other.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Active` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the agent is walking. Setting `Target` turns it on, and arriving turns it off. While it is off, the agent stands still. |
| `AgentType` | `string` | `""` | read/write | The name of the agent type, as defined with `NavigationService:DefineAgent`. When it is empty, the service's default type is used. |
| `MaxSpeed` | `number` | `8` | read/write | The agent's top speed, in meters per second. |
| `Target` | `vector` | — | read/write | The position the agent walks to. Setting it starts the walk. |

## Events

Signals are deferred: a handler runs at the next resumption point, not
inside the call that fired the signal.

### `Reached()`

Fires once when the agent arrives at `Target`.
